title: Invoice approval workflow
summary: Record an approve or reject decision on an invoice, notify finance, and keep an audit trail of the run.

secrets.name: INBOUND_HMAC_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret your approval UI uses to sign webhook bodies.

secrets.name: FINANCE_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the approval outcome JSON for your finance system or Slack incoming webhook.

setup: Publish the playbook and copy its webhook URL from Studio.
Point the invoice-approval-inbox starter at that URL with BALLET_WORKFLOW_URL, or use the REST execute endpoint with BALLET_API_KEY.
Approve or reject a sample invoice and confirm the finance webhook receives the outcome.
notes: This template records the human decision from your UI. It does not auto-approve invoices.
Replace FINANCE_WEBHOOK_URL with Slack, email, or your AP system as needed.
